rollups.text: Photography development timeline: On 2023-04-20, the user photographed blooming flowers and trees and tried macro photography for the first time; on 2023-05-21, he wanted to improve macro skills, create a cohesive photo series, and make a photo book. On 2023-04, he photographed his niece and nephew with a Sony Alpha a6400; on 2023-05-26, he described editing Red Rock Canyon photos in Lightroom and experimenting with manual focus. He also expressed interest in a month-long daily-life photo project and portrait photography. Elapsed time from the first dated photography activity to the latest dated report: about 36 days.

Cryptocurrency-market prediction system planning: On 2023-05-25, the user identified system components, favored PostgreSQL for modest volumes of structured exchange data and text, preferred evaluating an off-the-shelf monitoring solution, and treated testing and debugging as ongoing work rather than a component. He then broke down ingestion for Coinbase, Reddit, and Twitter, including identifying required data, authentication, retrieval, cleaning, normalization, and PostgreSQL storage. He next considered data processing and agreed that transformation should precede analysis. The planning progressed from architecture to ingestion and then processing within the same day.

Farmers’ market business development: By 2023-05-27, the user was selling granola successfully at a Saturday morning farmers’ market and considering adding savory flavored nuts, bundle discounts, and a more appealing stall. He considered a three-batch discount, a “Saturday Morning Farmers’ Market Bundle” priced 15% below its individual items, free shipping or a free gift for bulk purchases, and adding product photos and behind-the-scenes social content. On 2023-05-29, he was also developing promotion for freelance writing, but that was a separate service rather than a confirmed farmers’ market expansion. No nut launch, pricing adoption, or stall purchase was reported.

Freelance-writing promotion: During 2023-05-22..2023-05-28, the user collaborated with a graphic-designer friend to promote each other’s services on social media; the collaboration successfully reached a new audience. On 2023-05-29, the user planned to make a Canva before-and-after post with a caption, seek more collaborators through social media and online communities, pursue guest-blogging opportunities, and contact industry leaders. He was considering a lead magnet, but had not selected one. The sequence spans about seven days from the collaboration week to the follow-up plans.

Potential North Cascades road trip: On 2023-05-26, the user was considering a 4–5 day trip to North Cascades National Park and wanted to stop in Leavenworth. He asked about mountain-road conditions and driving, leaned toward staying downtown despite possible noise, and was especially interested in German food. He looked forward to trying schnitzel and sauerbraten with German beer, but no dates, booking, or completed trip were reported. Earlier, in April 2023, he had taken a separate solo road trip from Portland to San Francisco, stopping in Ashland for lunch.

Fitness routine and tracking: The user said on 2023-05-22 that he had restarted gym attendance on January 2 (year unspecified) and agreed to gym on Mondays, Thursdays, and Sundays, yoga on Tuesdays and Fridays, and rest on Wednesdays and Saturdays. He reported tight shoulders and chest with upper-body workouts and sought stretching guidance. He also wanted to track progress photos and measurements, but did not confirm choosing an app. The agreed schedule was a current plan, not evidence of sustained adherence.

Education trust planning: On 2023-05-20, the user wanted to ensure his child’s education would be well funded and considered establishing an education trust with a lump-sum contribution. He was considering whether stocks could be contributed and planned to consult an estate-planning attorney; he expressed uncertainty and sought examples for reassurance. No trust establishment or funding was reported.

Books and reading activities reported by the user: Jennifer Weiner’s “Who Did It” — attended a bookstore reading, met Weiner, and got a book signed on February 10 (year unspecified); Celeste Ng’s “Little Fires Everywhere” — joined a Facebook Live book-club discussion during 2023-05-15..2023-05-21; Goodreads Fantasy Book Club — expressed interest in joining on 2023-05-24, not confirmed as joined; “The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo” — had read and loved it and was buddy-reading it with friend Emily by 2023-05-24; “The Last Letter” — attended a local debut author’s launch party, date unspecified. He also planned a physical book journal and expressed interest in reading more debut authors on 2023-05-24.

Music interests and activities: The user reported listening to indie rock and seeking artists like The Black Keys on 2023-05-28; he specifically mentioned Arctic Monkeys and Foo Fighters and discovering artists through Spotify Discover Weekly. He often listens while commuting and was a beginner returning to guitar. His interest in music inspired him to consider writing songs again and seek songwriting resources. These are interests and plans, not confirmed course or resource use.

Barbecue and smoking foods the user reported making or enjoying: Korean-style BBQ beef short ribs made from an online recipe (2023-05-23); grilled chicken flavored with apple wood chips, which he liked (2023-05-23); smoked beef brisket cooked for four hours with hickory during 2023-05-19..2023-05-25, served with coleslaw and baked beans and enjoyed by his family; and Hwang’s bulgogi, which he especially liked after eating at three Korean BBQ restaurants (2023-05-29). He also reported experimenting with Korean-style marinade and gochujang and considering a bulgogi-centered dinner party; the party menu was not confirmed.

Pets and care routines: Rocky is the user’s puppy; he attended Saturday-morning training classes and was slowly learning sit and stay (undated). Rocky played with the user’s friend’s dog Bella during 2023-05-14..2023-05-20, and the user wanted more playdates. Luna is the user’s cat; the user said her teeth need daily brushing and planned to scoop her litter daily, replace all litter every 7–10 days, and set a Habitica reminder (2023-05-21 and undated follow-up).

Photography equipment and software the user reported using: Sony Alpha a6400 for photographing his niece and nephew in April 2023; Adobe Lightroom for organizing and editing photos and Adobe Photoshop for editing (reported by 2023-05-21); manual focus during a Red Rock Canyon hike, reported 2023-05-26. He has also experimented with presets and macro photography. These are user-reported tools or practices; suggested software and lenses are not included.

Budgeting and spending change: On 2023-05-25, the user was considering tracking expenses more closely and reducing luxury spending. He said he had switched from $10 name-brand toothpaste to a more affordable option at Target, and that he was now more drawn to H&M and Zara than designer boutiques. This records at least two reported shifts toward lower-cost purchases; he also raised concerns about fast fashion’s environmental impact, so the change does not establish an unqualified preference for fast fashion.

The user described two distinct volunteer or community-engagement intentions by 2023-05-29: considering weekly prayer meetings at a Baptist Church and deciding that regular volunteering at a nearby food bank would be a practical way to give back. No attendance at prayer meetings or completed food-bank volunteering was reported.
